title: Estrangement Between Banda Singh And Tat Khalsa

blocks.text: The rebuke becomes harsher: Banda is portrayed as unstable, cursed, and morally fallen, with domestic entanglements and pride turning him away from his earlier state.
Among the signs of that fall is the humiliating reference to randi and marriage, which the poet uses to show how far Banda has drifted from disciplined Khalsa identity.
The page is therefore less military than diagnostic, listing the visible marks of Banda’s inward corruption.
